edge_grammar.test_declaration: A test declaration is a function immediately governed by #[test] or #[tokio::test] in a pinned Rust blob.
edge_grammar.status_test_edge: An exact complete test-function identifier occurs in the status-row source text and resolves uniquely across pinned Rust test declarations.
edge_grammar.registry_test_edge: The pinned executable registry supplies an exact path and test-function pair which resolves to one pinned Rust test declaration.
edge_grammar.fixture_file_edge: An exact fixtures/ path in a status row resolves to one pinned schema.fixture inventory identity.
edge_grammar.tex_claim_edge: The complete displayed fixture label occurs as an exact token in one reviewed TeX source range.
edge_grammar.implementation_edge: A PascalCase public implementation symbol of at least six ASCII alphanumerics occurs as an exact Rust identifier in the executable test body after comments and literals are masked.
edge_grammar.noncollapse_law: Status assertion, registry membership, test declaration, test execution, claim incidence, implementation incidence, coverage, and semantic warrant remain distinct.

standing_law.predecessor_status: The exact source status label is retained as predecessor ledger evidence only.
standing_law.law: Neither PASS text, an executable route, nor an implementation/TeX incidence establishes successor standing or semantic correctness.

gate_law: Complete fixture classification closes only FORMAL-A-FIXTURE-INVENTORY. Formal Gate A remains pending until the independent joined coverage checker accepts the TeX, implementation, and fixture overlays together.
